secrets.name: OpenAIApiKey
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI chat assistant (https://platform.openai.com/api-keys). Optional — the app boots without it; only the AI Chat feature needs it.

secrets.name: GeminiApiKey
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for the AI card-recommendation assistant (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Optional — the app boots without it; only the AI assistant feature needs it.

secrets.name: RewardsCCApiKey
secrets.description: RewardsCC API key for fetching external credit card data (https://rewardscc.com). Optional — the app boots without it; only the external card fetch feature needs it.
